subject: oop
question: Difference between throw and throws.
title: Throw vs Throws
hook: Pulling a fire alarm vs a sign that says alarm may ring here.
answer: throw is a statement used inside a method body to explicitly raise one exception object (throw new Exception()).
throws is a clause in the method signature that declares the exceptions the method may pass to its caller.
throw actually raises the exception; throws only warns, raising nothing itself.
throw takes one exception object; throws can list several, separated by commas.
